execution.description: Built battery's Level-3 development variant from level-climb-1: the polish stage's quasi-Newton routine and line search as a declarative menu, in JAX, on the #611 pattern, with the Test Lead's attack-review guards.

expected: A second development level reuses Level 1's mechanism unchanged.
observed: Three Level-1-specific seams surfaced. The variant mechanism only accepted contract dimensions, and Level 3 had none (numerics was added). Every dispatch site keyed on Level 1's loss-expression record, so a Level-3 record would have rebuilt silently as Level 0. A level test assumed Levels 2 and 3 were unregistered. A state key named 'grad' in a custom optax transform also collided with the line search's own state, which optax looks up by key name.
keep: A level's default choice leaves no development record, so its rebuild is Level 0's byte for byte; test that, not just behaviour.
A new development level is dispatched explicitly at every rebuild site, with a test that the default stays Level 0.
Device-lane refusals are raised as Carbon's environment (ImportError in the staged program), never the candidate's fault.
change: Give the development-record dispatch one shared helper per Challenge rather than per-level branches at each site, before Level 2's variant lands.
Wire the recorded line-search evaluation caps into the training budget adapter once TRAINING-BUDGET-01 is on main.
